title: CronPay
tagline: Universal crypto payment gateway that merchants need to boost their sales (Coming soon to Shopify)

prizes.title: Best DeFi or Payments app with Avail Nexus SDK

description:
CronPay is a comprehensive crypto payment gateway built specifically for merchants who want to accept crypto payments without the complexity typically associated with blockchain transactions. The platform solves a critical problem in this ecosystem - enabling merchants to accept any token on any chain while receiving settlements in their preferred token and chain. No more managing multiple wallets or dealing with complex cross-chain operations. 

Key Features

1. Universal Payments - Accept any token on any chain
2. Unified Balance - View all assets across chains in one dashboard
3. Real-Time Analytics - Track payments, and revenue trends
4. Account Statements - Auto-generated for taxes and accounting
5. Fund Consolidation - One-click consolidation to your preferred token/chain
how_its_made:
Technologies
1. Avail Nexus SDK - The backbone of CronPay. Nexus enables seamless cross-chain transfers without centralized bridges. 
2. Pyth Price feeds - To get real-time, accurate price data for currency-token conversions.

Merchant Integration Flow
1. Merchant Registration
   - Merchant signs up on CronPay dashboard (app.cronpay.xyz)
   - Configures settlement preferences: token (e.g., USDT) and chain (e.g., Ethereum)
   - Generates API key 

2. Create Transaction
   - Merchant's backend calls CronPay API with order details and gets a transaction ID as response

3. Redirect to Gateway
   - Merchant redirects customer to CronPay gateway page with transaction ID

4. Customer Payment
   - Customer connects wallet and completes payment using their preferred token/chain with pricing displayed using Pyth feeds
   - CronPay handles cross-chain conversion via Nexus SDK

5. Status Polling
   - Merchant backend polls transaction status of the customer
